recommendations.text: Monitor the high severity of fall armyworm and medium severity of cutworm affecting sorghum in your plots. Take appropriate measures to control these pests.
Given the recent dry conditions, consider adjusting your planting schedule for the remaining sorghum crop. Ensure that irrigation is maintained for plot:003-2 to support the crop.
Keep an eye on market prices and consider selling your sorghum when prices are favorable.
